public.text: The section correctly warns against interpreting an interoperability layer as one centrally procured software product. However, it may understate the value that shared mediation, service discovery, audit, security, and routing infrastructure can provide.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the problem is not shared mediation itself, but treating interoperability as being fully delivered by one product. Shared infrastructure may realise selected mediation capabilities within a broader distributed interoperability architecture.
